messages.content: Help me generate a DMG setup script for an application named 'PhotoEditor' located at '/Applications/PhotoEditor.app', with a custom background image and ensuring the script reflects the correct volume URL and installation directory when creating a macOS package using jpackage?

function.name: MacDmgBundler_prepareDMGSetupScript
function.description: Prepares a DMG setup script for a macOS application package, including the volume URL, background image file, and installation directory. Note that the provided function is in Java 8 SDK syntax.

appLocation.description: The file system path string to the application location. This is Java String type parameter in string representation.

params.description: A map of parameters that may include the application name, images root, background image folder, and other packaging parameters. This is Java HashMap type parameter in string representation.

message.reasoning:
We need to call the function MacDmgBundler_prepareDMGSetupScript with appLocation '/Applications/PhotoEditor.app' and params string. We need to provide a map of parameters including application name, images root, background image folder, etc. The function expects a string representation of a Java HashMap. We need to produce a JSON string? The function signature: params: string. It says "This is Java HashMap type parameter in string representation." So we need to pass a string that represents a Java HashMap. For example: {"appName":"PhotoEditor","imagesRoot":"/path/to/images","backgroundImageFolder":"bg","volumeURL":"...","installDir":"..."} But we need to ensure correct volume URL and installation directory. The volume URL is typically /Volumes/PhotoEditor. The install dir is /Applications. So we can set volumeURL: "/Volumes/PhotoEditor" and installDir: "/Applications". Also background image path maybe "/path/to/background.png". Provide imagesRoot maybe "/path/to/images". Provide backgroundImageFolder maybe "bg". Provide appName: "PhotoEditor". Provide other packaging parameters maybe "appLocation": "/Applications/PhotoEditor.app". But appLocation is separate param. So we just need to pass the map.

Thus call function.
